parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 14 - Sword Art Online


Overview

Green Alien (Nameless) is a Secret Limited unit, he can only be obtained by evolving the unit Green Alien (Fusion).

Evolving

Green Alien (Nameless) can be evolved from Green Alien (Fusion) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
